name: Grand Cabin Hotel Naha Oroku
detail: Is this price really good?! It was an amazing cost-performance ratio. (When I stayed, it was about 3200 yen per night with breakfast included.) - A great location about 5 minutes from Akamine Station on the Yui Rail - Very good transportation to tourist spots like Karyushi Aquarium, Umikaji Terrace, and Kokusai Street - The room was spacious and comfortable - Both the shower room and toilet were very clean and reassuring - There are rentals available for hair dryers such as ReFa and Kinujo - Separate type loungewear is also available for rent - You can rent pillows according to your preference - The lobby is spacious, with drink service available (including shikwasa juice and alcohol) - Breakfast is a buffet-style rice porridge, very delicious, and refills are available Since I often go to Okinawa, I would like to use it again next time and I feel like recommending it to my friends. Thank you very much.

name: Hotel Abest Naha Kokusai Street
detail: The room had a double bed, but there was enough space for two people to spread out their suits. The staff's response was polite and left a lasting impression. Their warm touches included early check-in and a souvenir of sata andagi during checkout. I don't think there were body towels among the amenities.
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: All Friends Guest House
detail: It was a four-person dormitory, but instead of bunk beds, there were curtains from the ceiling, which somehow made me feel that privacy was somewhat preserved. The kitchen was very clean and had everything. There were also simple seasonings available. I think cooking for myself would not be a problem. The location is very good, so there is no inconvenience at all. The elevator is at the back of the building, which might be a bit hard to find. They were also able to hold my luggage before checking in and after checking out. If I had to point something out, the shower room is separated by gender and there is only one, and there is also only one toilet on each floor. That’s about it. There is also a place to hang laundry. There are plenty of hangers in the room as well.
area: Nago,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: Green Rich Hotel & Capsule Naha Artificial hot spring Futamata Yunohana
detail: I came to Naha for my child's hospital visit! Since it was summer vacation, I thought it would be nice to go to the pool and art museum with my child, so I chose this hotel for its convenience. There are quite a few shops around that might be a bit too stimulating for kids, but there is a convenience store nearby, and the monorail station is a 10-minute walk away. The staff at the hotel breakfast and the front desk during my late night inquiries were very nice. The bathroom was clean and comfortable, and I even managed to take a morning bath! The bed was very spacious, even for me and my 7-year-old child! The room was small, but it had an air purifier, a kettle, and a bathtub. I had a comfortable stay! Thank you very much!
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: Y's Cabin & Hotel Naha
detail: If you only need a place to sleep, it's a clean and very cost-effective accommodation. You can't store things like suitcases, but the front desk lends out chains. The large public bath was spacious and clean. I didn't particularly mind the noise from those around me. On the first floor, there's a simple drink bar and a place to eat food you bring in. It's located just one block back from Kokusai Street, making it quiet.
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: The Kitchen Hostel Ao
detail: There are personal lockers, making it easy to manage belongings. The water facilities are also clean. Both the station and Kokusai Street are relatively close and can be reached on foot. The owner is generous and kind. The hostel is located on the second floor, while the first floor has the reception and a cafe, where guests can consume their own food and drinks.
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: Daiwa Roynet Hotel Naha Kokusai-dori
detail: The fact that it is directly connected to Makishi Station, and that there is a supermarket and convenience store on the first floor made it very convenient. I arrived at the hotel sweaty, but the hallway to my room had a nice smell, and the room itself was clean with the cleaning staff being polite and professional.
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: APA HOTEL NAHAMATSUYAMA
detail: For about 10,000 yen per night, you get an Indian-style or Japanese-style buffet breakfast, a large public bath, fairly clean rooms, very comfortable beds, luggage storage service before and after check-in, and proximity to the bus stop, monorail, and Kokusai Street. I recommend it.
area: Naha,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: Phoenix Park Hotel
detail: There was a beautiful sandy beach just a short walk away, making it perfect for a stroll. The location was convenient with izakayas and restaurants serving Okinawan cuisine, as well as convenience stores within walking distance. The room was on the smaller side, but it had everything necessary, was clean, and provided a comfortable stay. The price was also reasonable. If I have the chance to come to Nago again, I think I would stay here once more.
area: Nago,Okinawa Main island - View on map

name: HOTEL THE CUBE Naha Kokusai Street
detail: I stayed here for 3 nights during my trip to Okinawa. It is located on Naha Street, and there are souvenir shops below, so you don't have to carry heavy bags around. You can also leave your luggage at the counter before check-in, and all the staff members are very kind. :) I usually prefer to use shared facilities to save on accommodation costs, so I didn't experience any inconvenience. Apart from the air conditioning not being adjustable, I had a comfortable stay :)
